annotations.title: Create a Microsoft Advertising conversion goal

description: Create a Microsoft Advertising CONVERSION GOAL, read back. type: Url (a thank-you page: urlExpression + urlOperator), Event (a UET custom event: eventAction / eventCategory / eventLabel / eventValue), OfflineConversion (conversions uploaded from a CRM with send_microsoft_ads_offline_conversions — no tag; Microsoft asks for 2 hours before the first upload), Duration (minimumDurationSeconds) or PagesViewedPerVisit (minimumPagesViewed). Every type but OfflineConversion needs tagId (create_microsoft_ads_uet_tag). category is required for Url / Event / Offline. Free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

category.description: conversion category, e.g. Purchase or Signup; required for Url, Event and OfflineConversion

countType.description: All or Unique: how repeat conversions are counted

currencyCode.description: 3-letter ISO currency code for the revenue value, e.g. USD

eventAction.description: Event goals: UET custom event action

eventCategory.description: Event goals: UET custom event category

eventLabel.description: Event goals: UET custom event label

eventValue.description: Event goals: numeric value attached to each event

minimumDurationSeconds.description: Duration goals: visit length in seconds that counts as a conversion

minimumPagesViewed.description: PagesViewedPerVisit goals: page count that counts as a conversion

revenue.description: FixedValue: the value of one conversion; VariableValue: the default

revenueType.description: FixedValue (one value per conversion), VariableValue or NoValue

scope.description: Account = this ad account only; Customer = shared across the customer

tagId.description: UET tag id from create_microsoft_ads_uet_tag; not needed for OfflineConversion

type.description: Url (thank-you page), Event (UET custom event), OfflineConversion, Duration or PagesViewedPerVisit

urlExpression.description: Url goals: the thank-you page URL or path to match

urlOperator.description: Url goals: how urlExpression matches the page: Equals, BeginsWith, Contains or RegularExpression

name: create_microsoft_ads_conversion_goal
title: Create a Microsoft Advertising conversion goal
